biological_interpretation: Reducing beta2-containing GABA-A receptor or calcium-extrusion components shifts thalamic excitability/activity feedback in a direction antagonistic to Ank3 scaffold loss, but gamma2 and beta1 subunits are not interchangeable.
caveats: Only three non-target genes were FDR significant; Fos and Npas4 were nominal and should be treated as supporting but not FDR-significant activity markers.
The literature links ATP2B1 and GABRB2 to calcium and inhibition, respectively, but does not establish a direct Ank3 coupling in this thalamic cell type.
The comparator perturbations had much stronger on-target FDRs than Gabrb1; therefore divergence could combine beta1-specific biology with weaker Gabrb1 perturbation.
Correlations were small, Gabrg2/Gabrb2 activity genes were cell-type restricted, and transcriptomic divergence does not prove distinct channel biophysics.
This is a transcriptomic contrast between perturbations with different guides and cell counts, not a matched receptor-composition or chloride-current assay.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Gabrb2 loss in 151 TH induced Nr4a1 and Vgf and aligned weakly with Gabra1, Gabrd, Slc12a5, and Atp2b1 perturbations; Atp2b1 or Gabrb2 up-regulated Nr4a1 and Fos in the opposite direction from Ank3-driven Opn3/Vgf repression, while Gabrb1 and Gabrg2 did not phenocopy Gabrb2. Parquet-verified leading rows: Gabrb2->Gabrb2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.07, FDR 3.15e-36; Gabrg2->Gabrg2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.05, FDR 4.66e-24; Gabrg2->Gabrg2 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -1.3, FDR 1.76e-23; Gabra1->Gabra1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.13, FDR 4.26e-18; Gabra1->Gabra1 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -1.59, FDR 3.24e-16; Gabrb2->Gabrb2 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -0.979, FDR 4.52e-15.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.summary: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut was the one robust downstream responder to Gabrb2 CRISPRi, coupling beta2 loss to Nr4a1 and Vgf induction rather than to a broad, ubiquitous stress program.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The selective induction of activity-associated Nr4a1 and Vgf nominates a thalamic glutamatergic population as a circuit context in which reduced Gabrb2 can be converted into a nuclear transcriptional response.

finding_summaries.summary: Gabrb2 and Atp2b1 were the top negative Ank3 signature neighbors, and direct Atp2b1/Gabrb2 perturbation upregulated several genes that Ank3 perturbation downregulated.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: This creates an experimentally testable hypothesis that calcium extrusion and GABA-A receptor perturbations elicit a counter-response to the Ank3 thalamic program.

finding_summaries.summary: Gabrb1 failed to phenocopy the activity-gene response caused by related GABA-A subunits: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Gabrb2 significantly upregulated Nr4a1 and Vgf and drove near-threshold Fos/Npas4 increases while Gabrb1 left the same genes near baseline; Gabrg2 significantly induced Vgf in 155 MB Glut whereas Gabrb1 did not.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: Beta and gamma GABA-A subunits participate in the same heteropentameric receptor family, but this dataset separates beta1 from beta2/gamma2 at the transcriptional-phenotype level instead of supporting simple subunit interchangeability.

finding_summaries.direction: divergent; only weak positive Gabra1-Gabrb2 convergence in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
finding_summaries.summary: Complex neighbors Gabrb2 and Gabrg2 were not interchangeable with Gabra1: beta2 or gamma2 knockdown could induce Vgf/Nr4a1/Fos-type activity genes in matched regions, whereas Gabra1 knockdown remained a sparse target-only signature.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The result refines the canonical alpha1-beta-gamma GABA-A receptor model by showing that different subunits of the same receptor family generate distinct transcriptomic consequences in this assay.

finding_summaries.summary: Gabrb2 and Gabrg2 were not interchangeable in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut despite both being GABA_A receptor subunits.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: In the same thalamic glutamatergic class, beta2 loss produced a Nr4a1/Vgf/Fos/Npas4/Homer2 program whereas gamma2 loss was almost purely on-target, arguing for subunit- and cell-context-specific receptor biology.

resolved_evidence.description: FDR-count screen showing that most engaged Gabrb2 perturbations did not yield additional transcriptome-wide hits.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Among the 9 cell classes with FDR-significant Gabrb2 depletion, 8 had exactly one FDR<0.05 gene, Gabrb2 itself: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 308 CB GABA. Only 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut had more than one FDR hit.

resolved_evidence.description: The only Gabrb2 perturbation context with multiple transcriptome-wide DE genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 140 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 4 genes passed FDR<0.05: Gabrb2 logFC -1.071 FDR 3.15e-36, Nr4a1 logFC 0.804 FDR 2.51e-4, Vgf logFC 0.573 FDR 0.00203, and Nalf1 logFC -0.310 FDR 0.00247. Fos logFC 0.840 and Npas4 logFC 0.896 were nominal at p=1.68e-5 and p=2.28e-5, both FDR 0.0563.

resolved_evidence.description: The dominant Ank3 downstream response was concentrated in thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic neurons.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 164 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 121 genes had FDR <0.05. Ank3 logFC -0.256 FDR 8.42e-05. Top FDR hits included Opn3 logFC -1.053 FDR 9.24e-11, Atp2a2 logFC -0.360 FDR 9.24e-11, Atp2b1 logFC -0.337 FDR 3.81e-10, Pcsk1n logFC 0.552 FDR 1.10e-08, Erc2 logFC -0.545 FDR 1.75e-08, Vgf logFC -0.852 FDR 2.40e-08, and Ache logFC -0.688 FDR 2.58e-08.

resolved_evidence.description: The strongest opposite-direction signatures to Ank3 perturbation in the responsive thalamic class targeted an inhibitory receptor subunit and a plasma-membrane calcium pump.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Among 2046 perturbations in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Gabrb2 was the most negative Ank3 full-score neighbor with r=-0.129 ranked 2046/2046, and Atp2b1 was second most negative with r=-0.116 ranked 2045/2046.

resolved_evidence.description: Genes downregulated by Ank3 perturbation were increased by the strongest negative-neighbor perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Direct Atp2b1 perturbation in 151 TH had Atp2b1 logFC -0.852 FDR 3.84e-28 and upregulated Opn3 logFC 0.621 FDR 0.00127, Vgf logFC 0.571 FDR 0.00248, Nr4a1 logFC 0.646 FDR 0.00356, and Fos logFC 1.026 FDR 0.000933. Direct Gabrb2 perturbation had Gabrb2 logFC -1.071 FDR 3.15e-36 and upregulated Nr4a1 logFC 0.804 FDR 0.000251 and Vgf logFC 0.573 FDR 0.00203.

resolved_evidence.description: The best sampled and strongest nominal Gabrb1 self-depletion contrast did not activate the immediate-early/activity markers observed after some related perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 139 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; Gabrb1 logFC -0.525, score -3.724, nominal p = 1.96e-4, FDR = 1.0; 0/17,259 genes had FDR < 0.05; Fos logFC 0.061, p = 0.542; Npas4 logFC 0.011, p = 0.907; Nr4a1 logFC 0.092, p = 0.623; Vgf logFC 0.065, p = 0.828.

resolved_evidence.description: A beta-subunit comparator in the same thalamic glutamatergic class produced strong on-target depletion and a compact activity-related signature.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 140 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; Gabrb2 logFC -1.071, FDR = 3.15e-36; Nr4a1 logFC 0.804, FDR = 2.51e-4; Vgf logFC 0.573, FDR = 0.00203; Nalf1 logFC -0.310, FDR = 0.00247; Fos logFC 0.840 and Npas4 logFC 0.896 with FDR = 0.0563; 4 genes had FDR < 0.05 and 10 had FDR < 0.10.

resolved_evidence.description: A gamma-subunit perturbation in midbrain glutamatergic cells showed strong on-target depletion and Vgf induction, unlike Gabrb1 in the same broad cell class.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 139 Gabrg2-perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls; Gabrg2 logFC -1.299, FDR = 1.76e-23; Vgf logFC 1.076, FDR = 0.00229; Fos logFC 1.156, FDR = 0.2005; Npas4 logFC 0.729, FDR = 1.0; Nr4a1 logFC 0.873, FDR = 0.932; 2 genes had FDR < 0.05.

resolved_evidence.description: Gabrb1 was nominally depleted in midbrain glutamatergic cells without reproducing the Gabrg2 Vgf/Fos/Npas4/Nr4a1 trend.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 119 perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls; Gabrb1 logFC -0.639, nominal p = 0.00807, FDR = 1.0; 0/17,443 genes had FDR < 0.05; Vgf logFC 0.187, p = 0.480; Fos logFC 0.487, p = 0.168; Npas4 logFC 0.018, p = 0.968; Nr4a1 logFC 0.409, p = 0.132.

resolved_evidence.description: Gabrb2, a GABA-A beta-subunit comparator, produced a clearer thalamic activity-linked response than Gabra1.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Gabrb2 perturbation had 140 perturbed cells and direct Gabrb2 depletion score -13.318, logFC -1.071, p=1.82e-40, FDR=3.15e-36. In the same signature, Nr4a1 was up score +5.547, logFC +0.804, FDR=2.51e-4; Vgf was up score +5.092, logFC +0.573, FDR=0.00203; Nalf1 was down score -5.001, logFC -0.310, FDR=0.00247; Fos and Npas4 were nominally up with FDR=0.0563. In the Gabra1 perturbation in the same cell type, Fos was only nominal, score +3.090, p=0.0020, FDR=1.0, and Nr4a1, Vgf, Npas4, and Nalf1 all had FDR=1.0.

resolved_evidence.description: Gabrg2, a GABA-A gamma-subunit comparator, produced Vgf/Fos/Nr4a1 signals that were absent from the strongly engaged Gabra1 155 MB Glut signature.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Gabrg2 perturbation had 139 perturbed cells and direct Gabrg2 depletion score -10.912, logFC -1.299, p=1.01e-27, FDR=1.76e-23. Vgf was up with score +5.148, logFC +1.076, p=2.63e-7, FDR=0.00229; Fos and Nr4a1 were nominally up with scores +4.142 and +3.407. In the Gabra1 perturbation in 155 MB Glut, Gabra1 itself was depleted with FDR=3.24e-16, but Vgf, Fos, Nr4a1, and Npas4 all had FDR=1.0.

resolved_evidence.description: Signature-neighbor analysis showed only weak convergence between Gabra1 and related GABAergic perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Pearson correlations with the Gabra1 signature, after excluding GABA receptor gene rows, were small across related perturbations. The largest related correlations were in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: Gabrb2 r=0.154, Spearman rho=0.104 over 17,242 genes; Gabrd r=0.131; Gphn r=0.117. Gabrb2 was also the second-ranked genome-wide positive neighbor of Gabra1 in this cell type, below Sgce r=0.159. Maximal related correlations in 052 Pvalb Gaba, 155 MB Glut, and 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut were 0.021, 0.022, and 0.027, respectively.

resolved_evidence.description: A same-cell-type contrast between two GABA_A receptor subunit perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Gabrg2 perturbation had n=166, Gabrg2 logFC -1.046 FDR 4.66e-24, and 0 non-target genes with FDR<0.10. Gabrb2 perturbation in the same class had n=140, Gabrb2 logFC -1.071 FDR 3.15e-36, and 8 non-target rows with FDR<0.10, including Nr4a1 logFC 0.804 FDR 2.51e-4, Vgf logFC 0.573 FDR 0.00203, Npas4 logFC 0.896 FDR 0.0563, Fos logFC 0.840 FDR 0.0563, and Homer2 logFC 0.412 FDR 0.0579.

title: Gabrb2 and Atp2b1 perturbations oppose the Ank3 thalamic state through Nr4a1/Fos/Vgf activity-gene induction
